name: 55416 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55416 (Minneapolis) has 337 nonprofit organizations. 171 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 149 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55416 (Minneapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
